SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(combined.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date
DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(combined.create_time, INTERVAL WEEKDAY(combined.create_time) DAY), '%Y-%m-%d') AS date
DATE_FORMAT(combined.create_time, '%Y-%m') AS date
CONCAT(YEAR(combined.create_time), '-Q', QUARTER(combined.create_time)) AS date
CONCAT(YEAR(combined.create_time), '-H', IF(MONTH(combined.create_time) <= 6, 1, 2)) AS date
CAST(YEAR(combined.create_time) AS CHAR) AS date
DATE_FORMAT(combined.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date
, COUNT(*) AS indexValue FROM ( SELECT create_time FROM point_activity WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT create_time FROM receive_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT create_time FROM card_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND pay_status IN ('已支付','已完成') AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} UNION ALL SELECT create_time FROM exchange_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= #{startTime} AND create_time <= #{endTime} ) combined GROUP BY date ORDER BY date ASC

SELECT ac.name AS activityName, IFNULL(ac.join_count, 0) / GREATEST( (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rr.user_id) FROM receive_record rr WHERE rr.deleted = 0 AND rr.receive_time >= #{startTime} AND rr.receive_time <= #{endTime}), 1 ) AS effectValue FROM activity_config ac WHERE ac.deleted = 0 AND ac.effect_time >= #{startTime} AND ac.effect_time <= #{endTime} ORDER BY effectValue DESC
